exposure: Different cervical ripening methods (dinoprostone insert, other prostaglandins, balloon catheter)
outcome: Women's experience of induction of labor
cohort: The study included all women undergoing induction of labor during one month in seven French perinatal networks.
finding: Cervical ripening was associated with a less positive experience of childbirth compared to oxytocin, only partly explained by interventions and complications of delivery.
